blocks.text: The kitchen shelves can hold the cookbooks if we drop the top one, in week 20 of the plan.
Two easy runs a week are enough to keep the base mileage up, in week 20 of the plan.
The migration is safe because every write goes to both databases, in week 20 of the plan.
Notes in the margin help me remember more of what I read, in week 20 of the plan.
Watering in the evening loses less to the sun than the morning does, in week 20 of the plan.
The long run moves to Saturday so Sunday can be a rest day, in week 20 of the plan.
